answer.reason: Several events of the story took place at Ramoth-gilead: the march of Ahab and Jehoshaphat to battle, Joram's wounding, and Jehu's anointing.

clauses.english: was where Ahab and Jehoshaphat went up to battle
clauses.quote: the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead

clauses.english: was where the Syrians wounded Joram in war
was where Jehu was anointed king over Israel
clauses.quote: I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel

doubts: 1KI 4:13 only places Geber's district in Ramoth-gilead, so it is left out.
Ahab's death at Ramoth-gilead is not stated in the verses given, so it is not claimed.
